newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan's CPC tenders to buy Nov/Dec fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's CPC tenders to buy Nov/Dec fuel oil.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy low sulphur fuel oil for delivery in November and December, a company official said on Wednesday.

The tender seeks one or more 38,000 tonne cargoes of 0.5 percent sulphur grade fuel oil for delivery between November 21 and December 20 and similar volume of 1.0-percent sulphur grade fuel oil for delivery between December 6-12.
The cargoes are for delivery to Taichung, Shen Ao or Keelung.
The tender closes October 22 and offers should be valid until October 24.
In its last tender, CPC purchased a 38,000-tonne cargo for delivery between November 16-December 10 at $141 per tonne on a cost-and-freight basis.
